# Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

**Authors:** Jason Wei, Xuezhi Wang, Dale Schuurmans, Maarten Bosma, Brian Ichter, Fei Xia, Ed H. Chi, Quoc V. Le, Denny Zhou  
**Year:** 2022  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.2201.11903](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2201.11903)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.11903](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.11903)

**Keywords:** chain-of-thought, reasoning, prompting

## Abstract

We explore how generating a chain of thought can improve the reasoning ability of large language models.
